origin.details: Count of non-missing values. grouping by several columns, grouped data frames, and zoo are not included. nthreads is accepted and the single-thread result is returned.
origin.value: A numeric vector, matrix, or data frame.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(collapse))
fNobs <- function(x, ...) fnobs(x, ...)
x <- c(1, NA, 3, 4, 5, NA)
g <- c("b", "a", "b", "a", "b", "a")
w <- c(1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1)
m <- matrix(c(1, NA, 3, 4, 5, 6), nrow = 3)
d <- data.frame(y = c(1, NA, 3), x = c(4, 5, 6))
gm <- c("b", "a", "b")
grab <- function(obj) {
  vals <- if (is.data.frame(obj)) as.numeric(unlist(obj, use.names = FALSE)) else as.numeric(obj)
  ifelse(is.na(vals), "NA", sprintf("%.17g", vals))
}

print(fnobs.default(x, g = g))
